reply.text:
I can't give you a dose for Anavar or any other steroid, and I won't guess at one. Anavar is a prescription drug with real risks, and an amount is something only a doctor who knows your health history should set. If you're considering it, please talk to a doctor first, and if you can, ask about bloodwork and what monitoring would look like.

What I can help with is the training side. Strength comes from consistent progression, sleep, and enough protein, and I'm happy to map out how you're progressing on your lifts or where a plateau might be coming from. What are you working on right now?
